tend.sentenceEn: Studies have shown that people who appear to be wealthy tend to be considered more intelligent, disciplined, and competent than those who do not.
tend.translationZh: 研究表明，与非富裕人群相比，看起来富裕的人往往被认为更聪明、更自律且更有能力。
tend.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第3句

tend.sentenceEn: Studies have found that people tend to be less open and less able to relax when they wear formal clothes.
tend.translationZh: 研究发现，人们穿正装时往往不那么开放，也不太能放松下来。
tend.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第2句

tend.sentenceEn: Teachers tend to still use this format because of either the need to control students or the belief that the teacher is the most important person in the room.
tend.translationZh: 教师们往往仍采用这种模式，究其原因，要么是出于控制学生的需要，要么是认为教师才是课堂上最核心的人物。
tend.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

tend.sentenceEn: They're also more likely to be in professional occupations where they tend to enjoy their work more.
tend.translationZh: 他们也更有可能从事专业性职业，并且往往在其中能获得更高的工作成就感。
tend.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第3句

tend.sentenceEn: What does a leader tend to do when they are committed to analytical decision-making?
tend.translationZh: 当一位领导者致力于通过分析来做出决策时，他们通常会怎么做？
他们倾向于提前为退休做准备。

type.sentenceEn: Science says that the clothes we wear affect our behavior, our mood and even the way we interact with others because of the symbolic meaning that we assign to different types of clothing.
type.translationZh: 科学表明，我们穿的衣服会影响我们的行为、情绪，甚至与他人互动的方式，这是因为我们赋予不同类型的服装以象征意义。
type.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第3句

type.sentenceEn: Aside from the link to type 2 diabetes, many studies agree that fruit juice is harmful if it contributes to an excess in calories.
type.translationZh: 除了与2型糖尿病有关联外，许多研究一致认为，如果果汁导致热量摄入过剩，那么它是有害的。

type.sentenceEn: Then on another day, at that same food market, people were given only 6 different types of jam choices.
type.translationZh: 后来有一天，还是在那个食品市场，人们只得到了6种不同的果酱可供选择。
type.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第5句

type.sentenceEn: Fans of classical music can also tell you that there are few types of music that are more expressive.
type.translationZh: 古典音乐爱好者也会告诉你，几乎没有哪种音乐比古典音乐更具表现力。
type.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

type.sentenceEn: Another study found a relationship between fruit juice and type 2 diabetes after following the diets and diabetes status of more than 70,000 nurses over 18 years.
type.translationZh: 另一项研究对7万多名护士进行了18年的饮食和糖尿病状况追踪，发现果汁与2型糖尿病之间存在关联。

type.sentenceEn: Different types of clothing markedly reflect different personalities.
type.translationZh: 不同类型的服装显著反映出不同的个性。

traditional.sentenceEn: Most imitation meats are highly processed and contain high amounts of sodium(钠) compared to traditional beef.
traditional.translationZh: 大多数人造肉属于高度加工食品，与传统牛肉相比钠含量也更高。
traditional.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第2句

traditional.sentenceEn: In addition to people being healthier and living much longer, economists say that a combination of financial considerations such as years of slow rise in real wages and a shift away from traditional pensions in the private sector are some of the reasons people delay retirement.
traditional.translationZh: 经济学家表示，除了人们身体更健康、寿命更长之外，由于实际工资增长多年停滞，以及私营部门从传统养老金制度转型等经济因素的共同作用，也是导致人们推迟退休的部分原因。
traditional.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

traditional.sentenceEn: Now our students have a range of different seating options, including a floor desk, couches, stools, bean bags, and the traditional desk-and-chair.
traditional.translationZh: 现在我们的学生有多种不同的座椅选择，包括地桌、沙发、凳子、豆袋椅，以及传统的课桌椅。
traditional.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第1句

traditional.sentenceEn: For us, flexible seating has meant removing most of the traditional chairs and desks and introducing a variety of different seating options to promote student engagement.
traditional.translationZh: 对我们而言，灵活排座意味着撤掉大部分传统的课桌椅，并引入多种不同的座位选择，以提升学生的参与度。
traditional.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第3句

traditional.sentenceEn: What happens traditionally to boosters, fuel tanks and other components in spaceflight?
traditional.translationZh: 在传统航天中，助推器、燃料箱和其他组件通常会发生什么情况？

traditional.sentenceEn: More and more people in the workplace find it hard to rely on traditional pensions.
traditional.translationZh: 职场中越来越多的人发现，依靠传统的退休金已变得愈发困难。

textbook.sentenceEn: If the public is to understand that science is an honorably self-correcting process, the idea that science is a fixed set of facts in a textbook needs to be dismissed.
textbook.translationZh: 如果公众要理解科学是一个值得尊重的自我修正过程，就需要摒弃那种认为科学是教科书中一成不变的既定事实的观念。
textbook.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第3句

textbook.sentenceEn: Printed textbooks that are not brand new, still contain the basic relevant information of core subjects.
textbook.translationZh: 不是全新的纸质教科书仍然包含核心科目的基本相关信息。
textbook.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第8段，第2句

textbook.sentenceEn: M: Our school is replacing printed textbooks with e-textbooks next semester.
textbook.translationZh: 男：我们学校下学期要把纸质教材换成电子教材了。
textbook.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

textbook.sentenceEn: But tablets contain many technological features that are not found in printed textbooks .
textbook.translationZh: 但是平板电脑有许多纸质教材所不具备的技术功能。
textbook.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第2句

textbook.sentenceEn: When taking a class in college, the author realized that a lot of information about Asian Americans was left out of the textbooks he studied.
textbook.translationZh: 作者在大学上课时意识到，他所学的教科书中遗漏了很多关于亚裔美国人的信息。
科学知识通过教科书传播。

tax.sentenceEn: The researchers put forth policy contributions, ranging from sustainable disposal of leftover stock to production tax to incentivize both manufacturers and consumers to be more waste conscious.
tax.translationZh: 研究人员提出了多项政策建议，包括可持续处理库存积压产品和征收生产税，以激励制造商和消费者提高浪费意识。
tax.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

tax.sentenceEn: W: I'm not sure of the exact figure, but it's a few million Euros, maybe five million Euros after tax .
tax.translationZh: 女：我不确定具体数字，但大概是几百万欧元，税后可能有五百万欧元。
tax.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第1句

tax.sentenceEn: M: In our family, we talk openly about things like the budget for holidays, how taxes reduce your income, and how to shop around for the best deals.
tax.translationZh: 男：在我们家，我们会开诚布公地谈论一些事情，比如假期预算、税收如何减少收入，以及如何货比三家找到最划算的交易。
tax.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

tax.sentenceEn: You indirectly support science through taxes you pay, products and services you purchase, and donations you make.
tax.translationZh: 你通过缴纳的税款、购买的产品和服务以及进行的捐赠，间接支持着科学事业。
tax.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第3句

tax.sentenceEn: Why did the researchers put forth such policies as production tax ?
tax.translationZh: 为什么研究人员提出了诸如生产税这样的政策？

tax.sentenceEn: Pay a green tax upon arrival.

trend.sentenceEn: The decline of manufacturing and the increase in the number of people working in less labor-intensive occupations also has contributed to the trend , says Abraham, who researches work and retirement decisions of older Americans.
trend.translationZh: 研究美国老年人工作与退休决策的专家亚伯拉罕指出，制造业的衰落以及从事体力劳动强度较低职业的人数增加，也共同推动了这一趋势。
trend.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

trend.sentenceEn: The overall trend is hitting Americans of all different levels of educational attainment, although the percentages vary by category.
trend.translationZh: 这一总体趋势影响着不同受教育程度的美国人，尽管各类的百分比有所不同。
trend.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第1句

trend.sentenceEn: Still, that's not always the case: When roused during REM sleep, 25% of the kids in Foulkes' studies had no recollection of dreaming, a trend that continues through age 9.
trend.translationZh: 不过，情况并不总是如此：在福克斯的研究中，当孩子们在快速眼动睡眠期间被唤醒时，25% 的孩子不记得自己做过梦，这种趋势一直持续到 9 岁。
trend.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第7句

trend.sentenceEn: Furthermore, this theory cannot explain the change in trend in the U.S. working week in the 1970s.
trend.translationZh: 此外，这一理论无法解释20世纪70年代美国工作周的趋势变化。

trend.sentenceEn: What is the general trend in people delaying retirement?
trend.translationZh: 延迟退休的普遍趋势是什么？

trend.sentenceEn: Watch closely the global trend in children's development.
trend.translationZh: 密切关注儿童发展的全球趋势。

teen.sentenceEn: Afterwards, the participants read a fictional survey of teens who wanted to "fight back against the companies by buying and eating less processed food"
teen.translationZh: 随后，参与者阅读了一项虚构的青少年调查，这些青少年希望通过减少购买和食用加工食品来“反击那些大公司”。
teen.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第4句

teen.sentenceEn: Psychologist David Foulkes studies children (from very small kids to teens ) to bring the secrets of their dreams to the light of day.
teen.translationZh: 心理学家大卫·福克斯通过研究从幼童到青少年的群体，揭开他们梦境中的秘密。
teen.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第5句

teen.sentenceEn: Unfortunately, while health education has shown some success among young children, teens have been harder to reach.
teen.translationZh: 遗憾的是，尽管健康教育在幼儿群体中取得了一定成效，但在青少年群体中却难以见效。
teen.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第3句

teen.sentenceEn: The teens chose healthy snacks and drinks (such as fruit or water) more often over unhealthy options (like biscuits and soda).
teen.translationZh: 比起饼干和汽水等不健康食品，这些青少年更常选择水果或水等健康零食和饮料。
teen.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第5句

teen.sentenceEn: Over a decade or so, American teens' social media use shifted from an occasional activity to a routine one.
teen.translationZh: 大约十余年间，美国青少年的社交媒体使用已从偶尔为之的活动转变为日常习惯。

teen.sentenceEn: They motivated teens to stay away from junk food only temporarily.
teen.translationZh: 他们仅仅是暂时激励了青少年远离垃圾食品。

thinking.sentenceEn: But part of Game Academy's suggestion is to transform casual gamers into "conscious" ones, applying critical thinking to developing their skills.
thinking.translationZh: 但 Game Academy 的部分建议是，将休闲玩家转变为“自觉型”玩家，运用批判性思维来提升他们的技能。

thinking.sentenceEn: "It also helps with meta-skills — learning how to learn, experimentation, and creative thinking ."
thinking.translationZh: 它也有助于培养元技能——即学习如何学习、勇于实验以及创新思维。

thinking.sentenceEn: This commitment, one right way of thinking or doing things, hinders the manager's flexibility.
thinking.translationZh: 这种固执于某种单一思维或办事方式的做法，阻碍了管理者的灵活性。
thinking.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第3句

thinking.sentenceEn: We believe our thinking today is evolved; Ford shows us it's not.
thinking.translationZh: 我们以为自己的思想已经与时俱进，而福特却向我们证明并非如此。
thinking.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第4句

thinking.sentenceEn: Game Academy proposes to help gamers develop their skills using critical thinking .
thinking.translationZh: Game Academy 旨在通过批判性思维帮助玩家提升游戏技能。

talent.sentenceEn: With those born with natural talents , it feels as if they excel without really trying.
talent.translationZh: 那些天生有才的人，似乎毫不费力就能出类拔萃。
talent.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

talent.sentenceEn: Many other designers and architects have expressed concern over the future supply of home-grown talent for UK firms, and industry bodies have pointed out that there has been a lack of roots-level support.
talent.translationZh: 许多其他设计师和建筑师对英国公司本土人才的未来供应表示担忧，行业机构也指出，在基层支持方面存在不足。

talent.sentenceEn: But what about those of us who don't have a natural talent ?
talent.translationZh: 但是我们这些没有天赋的人该怎么办呢？
talent.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

talent.sentenceEn: "As much as talent counts, effort counts twice," says Duckworth in Grit.
talent.translationZh: 达克沃斯在《坚毅》一书中写道：“天赋固然重要，但努力的作用是天赋的两倍。”
talent.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

talent.sentenceEn: What does Duckworth say about talent ?
talent.translationZh: 达克沃斯对天赋有何看法？

talent.sentenceEn: They have little talent for learning math.
talent.translationZh: 他们在学习数学方面天赋不足。

teaching.sentenceEn: Personal teaching is about teachers showing students a higher path, and about young people going through the process together.
teaching.translationZh: 个性化教学在于教师为学生指引更高远的道路，在于年轻人共同经历成长的过程。
teaching.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

teaching.sentenceEn: Distance education will never match the personal teaching in a traditional classroom.
teaching.translationZh: 远程教育永远无法与传统课堂中的个性化教学相媲美。
teaching.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第4句

teaching.sentenceEn: Many students drop out of online courses because of the lack of teaching support.
teaching.translationZh: 许多学生因缺乏教学支持而退出在线课程。
teaching.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

teaching.sentenceEn: Professor Ashok Goel of Georgia Tech developed an artificially intelligent teaching assistant to help handle the enormous number of student questions in the online class, Knowledge-Based Artificial Intelligence.
teaching.translationZh: 佐治亚理工学院的阿肖克·戈尔教授开发了一个人工智能教学助手，以帮助处理在线课程《基于知识的人工智能》中学生提出的大量问题。
teaching.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

teaching.sentenceEn: How does teaching others benefit student tutors?
teaching.translationZh: 教授他人如何使学生导师受益？

teaching.sentenceEn: She incorporates smartphones into her teaching .
teaching.translationZh: 她将智能手机融入教学中。

track.sentenceEn: A video from the project shows a train of autonomous robots running along a track without bilateral control; they eventually back up in phantom jams.
track.translationZh: 该项目的一段视频显示，一列自主机器人沿着轨道运行，没有进行双边控制；它们最终在幽灵拥堵中后退。

track.sentenceEn: According to Benjamin M.Friedman, an economist at Harvard, the U.S. economy is right on track to reach Keynes's eight-fold(八倍) multiple by 2029.
track.translationZh: 哈佛大学经济学家本杰明·M·弗里德曼认为，美国经济正按计划在2029年达到凯恩斯提出的八倍乘数效应。

track.sentenceEn: A deadly snake, which had finally been tracked down after escaping a zoo, has slipped away for the second time.
track.translationZh: 一条致命毒蛇在从动物园逃脱后终于被追踪到，却再次溜走了。
track.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

track.sentenceEn: Because there is a delayed satisfaction associated with self-control, it can be easy to get off track .
track.translationZh: 由于自制力带来的满足感具有延迟性，人们很容易偏离正轨。
track.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第1句

track.sentenceEn: Fraudsters keep changing their bank accounts to avoid being tracked .
track.translationZh: 诈骗者不断更换银行账户以避免被追踪。
它无法追踪学生的成长。

theory.sentenceEn: The other main theory , which is more recent, is that people started off by gesturing—pointing at things with their hands and imitating actions using their bodies.
theory.translationZh: 另一个较新的主要理论是，人类最初是通过手势交流——用手指向物体，并通过身体模仿动作。
theory.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

theory.sentenceEn: The reason they switched to making sounds, the theory goes, is that talking out loud lets you communicate with someone even when you can't see them.
theory.translationZh: 该理论认为，他们转向发声交流的原因是，即使在看不见对方的情况下，大声说话也能让你与他人沟通。
theory.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第5句

theory.sentenceEn: The first theory is that language started with people making different sounds, mostly imitating the things around them, like animal calls, nature sounds, and the sounds of tools.
theory.translationZh: 第一种理论认为，语言起源于人们发出的各种声音，主要是模仿周围的事物，比如动物的叫声、自然界的声音以及工具发出的声响。
theory.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句
文章原文 · 第1段，第6句

theory.sentenceEn: This theory guesses that after developing sign languages, people eventually started making sounds along with their gestures.
theory.translationZh: 该理论推测，在发展出手语之后，人们最终开始在做手势的同时发出声音。
theory.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第3句

theory.sentenceEn: Why did people switch from gesturing to making sounds according to the more recent theory ?
theory.translationZh: 根据较新的理论，人们为什么从手势交流转向发声交流？

tradition.sentenceEn: When snowy weather arrives in the US, it means the chance of school children benefiting from the long-standing tradition of the "snow day", when schools are forced to close and students get an unexpected day off.
tradition.translationZh: 当美国迎来降雪天气时，这意味着学龄儿童有机会享受由来已久的“雪天”传统——学校被迫停课，学生们意外获得一天假期。

tradition.sentenceEn: But the tradition is now over for pupils in several US states such as South Carolina, Nevada, Georgia and Indiana.
tradition.translationZh: 但这一传统如今在南卡罗来纳州、内华达州、佐治亚州和印第安纳州等美国多个州的学生中已成为过去。

tradition.sentenceEn: It will also bring to an end a less popular US high school tradition : the "make-up day", which requires students in many states to make up the time lost due to weather by working during school holidays.
tradition.translationZh: 这也将终结美国高中一个不太受欢迎的传统："补课日"。在许多州，学生因天气原因耽误的课时需要通过在学校假期补课来弥补。

tradition.sentenceEn: Vegetable planting has a respectable tradition .
tradition.translationZh: 蔬菜种植有着悠久的传统。
tradition.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

tradition.sentenceEn: There is a time-honoured tradition in the US for school kids to stay at home on "snow days".
tradition.translationZh: 在美国，学校孩子们在“雪天”待在家里是一个由来已久的传统。

tradition.sentenceEn: It marks the end of a time-honoured tradition .
tradition.translationZh: 这标志着一项历史悠久传统的终结。

threat.sentenceEn: This type of snake is classified as a threat to humans, especially small children, as well as pets.
threat.translationZh: 这种蛇被归类为会对人类（尤其是小孩）以及宠物构成威胁的物种。
threat.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第3句

threat.sentenceEn: Consequently, being replaced by a robot or software poses less of a threat to their feeling of self-worth.
threat.translationZh: 因此，被机器人或软件取代对他们的自我价值感威胁较小。
threat.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

threat.sentenceEn: The American Civil Liberties Union has stated that digital assistants create a threat to privacy from hackers.
threat.translationZh: 美国公民自由联盟指出，数字助手带来了黑客入侵隐私的威胁。

threat.sentenceEn: While this can be good news for the world's poorest people who now consume more calories, protein and fat than in the past, homogeneity(同一性) and over-dependence on a handful of staples leave us vulnerable to threats such as drought, disease and pests—all of which are predicted to worsen in many parts of the world as a result of climate change.
threat.translationZh: 虽然这对世界上最贫困的人群来说可能是个好消息——他们现在摄入的热量、蛋白质和脂肪比过去都有所增加，但饮食的同一性以及对少数几种主食的过度依赖，使我们容易受到干旱、疾病和虫害等威胁的影响。而气候变化预计将导致这些威胁在世界许多地区进一步加剧。

threat.sentenceEn: Why are wild pigs a threat to humans?
threat.translationZh: 为什么野猪会对人类构成威胁？

threat.sentenceEn: Flee from the threat of bears.

thus.sentenceEn: In fact, researchers found that connections and thus communication—between parts of different brain networks are actually stronger in people who had hemispherectomies than in people with intact brains.
thus.translationZh: 事实上，研究人员发现，在接受过半脑切除术的患者中，不同大脑网络各部分之间的连接——以及由此产生的交流——实际上比大脑完整的人更强。
thus.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第3句

thrive.sentenceEn: It is urgent to provide an ideal habitat for them to thrive .
thrive.translationZh: 为它们提供一个理想的栖息环境以促进其繁衍生息，已成为当务之急。

totally.sentenceEn: I think they're totally worth it.

totally.translationZh: 好不容易挤出来后，我已经筋疲力尽了。

totally.sentenceEn: A totally different approach could be adopted to combat advertising campaigns for snack food.
totally.translationZh: 可以采取一种完全不同的方法来应对零食广告攻势。

trace.sentenceEn: This need to be liked can be traced back to when we were children and were completely dependent on others to take care of us: Small children are not just learning how to walk and communicate, they are also trying to learn how the world works.
trace.translationZh: 这种渴望被他人喜欢的需求可以追溯到我们还是孩子、完全依赖他人照顾的时期：小孩子不仅在学习走路和交流，他们也在努力了解世界是如何运作的。
trace.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

trace.sentenceEn: It would be common sense for people to use small tents and leave no trace of their visit.

trace.sentenceEn: He was only found the first time around because staff brought in a special machine to trace him inside a wall opening.
trace.translationZh: 第一次找到他，仅仅是因为工作人员带来了一台特殊机器，才在墙洞里追踪到了他。
trace.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第5句

trace.sentenceEn: They simply vanish without a trace .
trace.translationZh: 他们就这么消失得无影无踪。

trace.sentenceEn: Contrary to parents' belief, kids try hard to leave as few traces as possible on the web.
trace.translationZh: 与父母的看法相反，孩子们努力在网络上留下尽可能少的痕迹。

trace.sentenceEn: Leave no trace of their camping.

traveler.sentenceEn: Our analysis suggests early booking by women can translate into savings of $1 million a year for a large multinational company with 20,000 regular travelers .
traveler.translationZh: 我们的分析表明，对于一家拥有20,000名常旅客的大型跨国公司而言，女性员工提前预订机票每年可节省100万美元。
traveler.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第3句

traveler.sentenceEn: We wanted to determine what was causing these gender differences in booking business trips so we tested a variety of possible explanations, such as women choosing to plan ahead or male frequent travelers being inclined to book late.
traveler.translationZh: 我们希望确定是什么导致了商务旅行预订中的这些性别差异，因此我们测试了多种可能的解释，例如女性倾向于提前规划行程，或者男性常旅客更倾向于延迟预订。
traveler.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

traveler.sentenceEn: Helicopter taxi is not an affordable option for many travelers .
traveler.translationZh: 直升机出租车并非许多旅客负担得起的选择。
traveler.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

traveler.sentenceEn: "A large number of high-class travelers , including CEOs, have to spend more than three hours by road to get there and that is a loss of time," a Bangalore airport spokesperson said.
traveler.translationZh: 班加罗尔机场发言人称：“包括首席执行官在内的众多高端旅客经公路前往机场通常需要三个多小时，这无疑是时间上的损失。”
traveler.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第4句

traveler.sentenceEn: American travelers seem the least affected.
traveler.translationZh: 美国游客似乎受影响最小。
traveler.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第6句

traveler.sentenceEn: It impacts female travelers more seriously.
traveler.translationZh: 这对女性旅行者的影响更为严重。

tackle.sentenceEn: In England, there has been a focus on tackling absenteeism(旷课) from school.
tackle.translationZh: 在英国，人们一直关注如何解决学生旷课问题。

tackle.sentenceEn: A recent study tackles the issue of over-trusting drivers and the resulting system misuse from a legal viewpoint.
tackle.translationZh: 最近的一项研究从法律角度探讨了驾驶员过度信任以及由此导致的系统滥用问题。
tackle.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第3句

tackle.sentenceEn: Researchers in Iceland found a new way of tackling climate change by pumping carbon dioxide underground and turning it into stone.
tackle.translationZh: 冰岛研究人员发现了一种应对气候变化的新方法——将二氧化碳泵入地下并将其转化为石头。
tackle.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

tackle.sentenceEn: "But unless we accept that obesity is a disease, we are not going to be able to tackle it," he concludes.
tackle.translationZh: 他总结道：“但除非我们承认肥胖是一种疾病，否则我们将无法解决这个问题。”
tackle.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第3句

tackle.sentenceEn: What does the author think schools should do to tackle cheating?
tackle.translationZh: 作者认为学校应该做些什么来解决作弊问题？

tackle.sentenceEn: Tackle the most difficult task first.

threaten.sentenceEn: Environmentalists have long believed that building roads or homes near the bears may threaten their survival by "reducing or fragmenting their natural: habitats", The Times reported.
threaten.translationZh: 《泰晤士报》报道，环保人士长期以来认为，在熊类栖息地附近修建道路或房屋可能会通过“减少或分割它们的自然栖息地”来威胁其生存。
threaten.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

threaten.sentenceEn: Over the coming decades, millions of jobs will be threatened by robotics and artificial intelligence.
threaten.translationZh: 在未来几十年里，数百万个工作岗位将受到机器人技术和人工智能的威胁。
threaten.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

threaten.sentenceEn: The status of the upper classes was threatened ; fashion was a tool to preserve it.
threaten.translationZh: 上层阶级的地位受到了威胁；时尚成为他们维系地位的工具。
threaten.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第3句

threaten.sentenceEn: If a new competitor emerges to threaten your business, you may need to change direction, even if that means straying from your original vision.
threaten.translationZh: 如果有新的竞争对手出现并威胁到你的业务，你可能需要改变方向，即使这意味着偏离你最初的愿景。
threaten.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第3句

threaten.sentenceEn: They also harbor dozens of diseases that threaten both humans and farm animals.
threaten.translationZh: 它们还携带数十种威胁人类和农场动物的疾病。
threaten.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

threaten.sentenceEn: Housing development near pandas' homes may threaten their survival.
threaten.translationZh: 熊猫栖息地附近的住房开发可能威胁它们的生存。

teamwork.sentenceEn: "There are plenty of soft skills that gamers can utilise in a professional setting, such as teamwork , problem solving and strategic planning," says Ryan Gardner, a regional director with Hays recruitment.
teamwork.translationZh: 海斯招聘公司的区域总监瑞安·加德纳表示：“玩家可以将许多软技能运用到职场中，例如团队合作、问题解决能力以及战略规划。”

teamwork.sentenceEn: Besides, teamwork and leadership rely heavily on the power of persuasion to get things done.
teamwork.translationZh: 此外，团队合作和领导力在很大程度上依赖说服力来推动工作完成。
teamwork.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

teamwork.sentenceEn: A vast majority of people prefer collaboration and teamwork over traditional organizational structures; no one likes to be told what to do or to be pushed around.
teamwork.translationZh: 绝大多数人更喜欢协作与团队合作，而非传统的组织结构；没人喜欢被指手画脚或受人摆布。
teamwork.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第2句

teamwork.sentenceEn: In fact many experts argue that the most important 21st-century skills aren't related to specific technologies or subject matter, but to creativity; skills like imagination, problem-finding and problem-solving, teamwork , optimism, patience and the ability to experiment and take risks.
teamwork.translationZh: 事实上，许多专家认为，21世纪最重要的技能与特定技术或学科内容无关，而是与创造力相关；这些技能包括想象力、发现问题与解决问题的能力、团队合作精神、乐观态度、耐心，以及进行实验和承担风险的能力。
teamwork.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

teamwork.sentenceEn: But a new report by Deloitte, "Global Human Capital Trends", based on a survey of more than 7,000 executives in over 130 countries, suggests that the fashion for teamwork has reached a new high.
teamwork.translationZh: 但德勤公司最新发布的《全球人力资本趋势》报告显示，团队合作的热潮已达到新高度。该报告基于对130多个国家7000多名高管的调查。

teamwork.sentenceEn: Teamwork is most effective when team members share the same culture.
teamwork.translationZh: 当团队成员拥有共同的文化时，团队合作最为有效。

transition.sentenceEn: We also investigated the social side of the high school transition .
transition.translationZh: 我们还研究了高中过渡期的社交方面。

transition.sentenceEn: Given all that's riding on having a successful ninth grade experience, it pays to explore what can be done to meet the academic, social and emotional challenges of the transition to high school.
transition.translationZh: 鉴于九年级的成功体验关系重大，探索如何应对升入高中所面临的学业、社交和情感挑战是值得的。

transition.sentenceEn: Ultimately it should matter to the students themselves and society at large, because students' experience of transitioning (过渡) to the ninth grade can have long-term consequences not only for the students themselves but for their home communities.
transition.translationZh: 最终，这既关乎学生自身，也关乎整个社会，因为学生升入九年级的过渡体验不仅会对学生本人产生长期影响，也会对其家庭所在的社区产生长远后果。

transition.sentenceEn: But walking is faster than crawling, so this motivates expert crawlers to transition to walking.
transition.translationZh: 但走路比爬行更快，因此这促使爬行熟练的婴儿向行走过渡。
transition.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第6句

transition.sentenceEn: A three-stage life has few transitions , while a multi-stage life has many.
transition.translationZh: 三阶段人生几乎没有转型期，而多阶段人生则有许多转型期。

transition.sentenceEn: Product transitions take much less time now than in the past.
transition.translationZh: 如今产品转型所需的时间比过去少得多。

trial.sentenceEn: Almost 75% of U.S. clinical trials in medicine are paid for by private companies.
trial.translationZh: 美国近75%的医学临床试验由私营企业资助。
trial.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第6句

trial.sentenceEn: When trial participants were asked to choose between photographs of faces of a different race from theirs, response times were slower and selections were 5% less accurate.
trial.translationZh: 当试验参与者被要求在与自己不同种族的人脸照片中进行选择时，他们的反应时间更慢，选择准确率也低了5%。
trial.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第2句

trial.sentenceEn: The trial assessed the effectiveness of an early mathematics intervention(干预) aimed at preschoolers.
trial.translationZh: 该试验评估了针对学龄前儿童开展早期数学干预的效果。

trial.sentenceEn: A team of researchers from the University of York conducted a randomized(随机的) control trial with 691 depressed patients from 83 physician practices across England.
trial.translationZh: 约克大学的一组研究人员对来自英格兰83个医师诊所的691名抑郁症患者进行了一项随机对照试验。
trial.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

trial.sentenceEn: We learn, in a sense, by trial and error.
trial.translationZh: 从某种意义上说，我们是通过反复尝试和从错误中学习的。

trial.sentenceEn: How many patients gained a complete remission in the small trials ?
trial.translationZh: 在小型试验中有多少患者获得了完全缓解？

trick.sentenceEn: That's why brain scientist Richard Kennedy says "It's not that old dogs can't learn new tricks . It's that maybe old dogs don't realize why they should."
trick.translationZh: 这就是为什么脑科学家理查德·肯尼迪说：“并不是老狗学不会新把戏，而是老狗可能没意识到为什么要学。”
trick.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第6句

trick.sentenceEn: The trick is to be active.
trick.translationZh: 关键在于要让自己行动起来。

trick.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第10句

trick.sentenceEn: "In post-war Japan, the economy wasn't doing so great, so you couldn't get everyday-use items like household cleaners," says Lisa Katayama, author of Urawaza, a book named after the Japanese term for clever lifestyle tips and tricks .
trick.translationZh: 《生活小窍门》(Urawaza)一书的作者片山丽萨(Lisa Katayama)说：“战后日本经济不太景气，像家用清洁剂这类日常用品都很难买到。”Urawaza这个书名源于日语，指的是巧妙的生活技巧和窍门。
trick.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第13句

trick.sentenceEn: Today's shaky economy is likely to produce many more such tricks .
trick.translationZh: 如今动荡的经济很可能会催生更多这类妙招。
trick.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第12句

trick.sentenceEn: There are tricks to increase customer satisfaction.
trick.translationZh: 有一些提高客户满意度的技巧。

testing.sentenceEn: While certain rare diseases can be easily identified, most potential health conditions cannot be identified by genetic testing alone.
testing.translationZh: 虽然某些罕见疾病可以被轻易识别，但大多数潜在健康状况并不能仅通过基因检测来确定。
testing.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第2句

testing.sentenceEn: With genetic testing becoming increasingly popular, many people are left wondering exactly how accurate it is.
testing.translationZh: 随着基因检测变得日益普及，许多人不禁开始好奇，它的准确性究竟如何。

testing.sentenceEn: If all four bills pass as written, they would represent a substantial update of Michigan's 2013 law that allowed the testing of self-driving vehicles in limited conditions.

thief.sentenceEn: It would now be difficult for an intern, visitor or a thief to steal a document like this.
thief.translationZh: 如今，无论是实习生、访客还是小偷，都很难再偷走这样的文件了。

thief.sentenceEn: It means that a thief likely wouldn't be able to Google how the system works, then figure out a way around it.
thief.translationZh: 这意味着窃贼很可能无法通过谷歌搜索到该系统的工作原理，从而找到破解方法。

thief.sentenceEn: Every one of them has vulnerabilities that a knowledgeable thief could theoretically exploit.
thief.translationZh: 每一种安防系统都存在潜在漏洞，理论上可能被有经验的窃贼利用。

thief.sentenceEn: First, a thief is going to need to target your home, specifically.
thief.translationZh: 首先，盗贼需要专门盯上你家。

timely.sentenceEn: In situations where you need more timely action, decisions based on some information and instinct may work better.

timely.sentenceEn: Instead, they suggest it may be more of a lifelong process—a continuous, never-ending exercise that requires self-awareness and timely adjustments.
timely.translationZh: 相反，他们认为这更可能是一个终身过程——一种持续不断、永无止境的实践，需要自我认知和适时调整。

timely.sentenceEn: Much has been written about the importance of timely feedback.
timely.translationZh: 关于及时反馈的重要性，已有诸多论述。
timely.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

timely.sentenceEn: Adequate and timely IT support should also be available to enable users to cope with technological issues at work.
timely.translationZh: 企业还应提供充分且及时的IT支持，以帮助用户应对工作中的技术问题。

timely.sentenceEn: Why is it important for firms to provide timely feedback during the pandemic?
timely.translationZh: 为什么企业在疫情期间提供及时反馈很重要？

timely.translationZh: 他们中的大多数人都能及时得到老师的帮助。

tissue.sentenceEn: The scientist confirmed the snake was a previously unknown species after conducting a genetic analysis of tissue samples.
tissue.translationZh: 这位科学家在对组织样本进行基因分析后，确认这种蛇是此前未知的物种。

tasty.sentenceEn: Get outside, stretch your legs, do something cultural, buy yourself something tasty to eat or something pretty to wear.

tasty.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第10句

tasty.sentenceEn: Nonetheless, the renewed focus on waistlines means that industry groups are under pressure to demonstrate their products are healthy as well as tasty .
tasty.translationZh: 然而，人们对腰围问题的重新关注意味着行业团体面临压力，需要证明其产品既健康又美味。
tasty.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

tasty.sentenceEn: As he lay in the hospital recovering, Harper imagined the line of healthy frozen foods—the tasty good.
tasty.translationZh: 躺在医院康复期间，哈珀构想了一系列健康冷冻食品——既美味又有益健康的食品。
tasty.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第3句

tasty.sentenceEn: What is the more recent effort by food companies to make foods and drinks both healthy and tasty ?
tasty.translationZh: 食品公司最近为了使食品和饮料既健康又美味做出了什么努力？

tasty.sentenceEn: She doesn't deem homemade soup tasty .
tasty.translationZh: 她觉得家里做的汤不好喝。

tear.sentenceEn: There are cognitive(认知的) benefits of doing things the way we did as children—building something, tearing it down, then building it up again.
tear.translationZh: 像我们小时候那样做事——搭建东西、拆掉它，然后再重新搭建起来——对认知能力是有好处的。
tear.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

tear.sentenceEn: Everything about the look and feel of a wallet—the way the fastenings and materials wear and tear and loosen with age, the plastic and paper and gold and silver, and handwritten phone numbers and printed cinema tickets—is the very opposite of what our world is becoming.
tear.translationZh: 钱包的外观和触感——搭扣与材质随岁月流逝而磨损松动的样子，里面的塑料卡片、纸币、金银饰品，还有手写的电话号码和打印的电影票——这一切都与我们这个世界正在变成的样子截然相反。
tear.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第3句

tear.sentenceEn: When muscles perform an activity they aren't regularly exposed to, the tiny fibres that are inside them are being torn apart.
tear.translationZh: 当肌肉进行不常接触的活动时，其内部的细小纤维会被撕裂。
tear.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第5句

tear.sentenceEn: As muscle soreness develops, the body has to work to repair the muscle tears .
tear.translationZh: 当肌肉酸痛出现时，身体就必须开始修复肌肉的撕裂。
tear.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第6句

tear.sentenceEn: The other day, he came home from school almost in tears .
tear.translationZh: 前几天，他放学回家时几乎要哭了。
tear.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

tear.sentenceEn: They must endure wear and tear .
tear.translationZh: 它们必须能够经受磨损。

teenage.sentenceEn: Digital entrepreneur and business consultant Mia Bennett says: "In more traditional settings, gaming is still imagined to be the pursuit of teenage boys — a waste of time."
teenage.translationZh: 数字企业家兼商业顾问米娅·贝内特（Mia Bennett）表示：“在传统观念中，人们仍然认为电子游戏是青少年的消遣——纯粹是在浪费时间。”

teenage.sentenceEn: The child had taken the keys to the family car while his teenage sister was napping.
teenage.translationZh: 原来，趁十几岁的姐姐午睡时，这个孩子拿走了家里汽车的钥匙。
teenage.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第5句

teenage.sentenceEn: But even when these accounts touch on real concerns, they do not really reflect the great mass of everyday teenage social behaviour: the online chat, the texting, the surfing, and the emergence of a new teenage sphere that is conducted digitally.
teenage.translationZh: 但即便这些报道触及了真实的担忧，它们也未能真正反映青少年日常社交行为的全貌：在线聊天、发送短信、网络浏览，以及一个全新的数字化青少年社交领域的出现。

teenage.sentenceEn: Phones influence all aspects of teenage life.
teenage.translationZh: 手机影响着青少年生活的方方面面。
teenage.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

teenage.sentenceEn: Our recently published study answered this question by tracking a large national random sample of Americans over a critical time period when bodies change from teenage shape into adult form and when people build their identities.
teenage.translationZh: 我们最近发表的研究通过追踪一个大型全国性随机美国人样本，回答了这一问题。追踪时间跨度为一个关键时期：在此期间，身体从青少年形态转变为成人形态，人们也在构建自己的身份认同。
teenage.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第1句

teenage.sentenceEn: West Windsor-Plainsboro has not had a teenage suicide in recent years, but Aderhold, who has worked in the district for seven years and been chief for the last three years, said he had seen troubling signs.
teenage.translationZh: 西温莎-普兰斯伯勒学区近年来并未发生过青少年自杀事件，但在该学区工作了七年、担任学监三年的阿德霍尔德表示，他已注意到一些令人不安的迹象。

temporary.sentenceEn: Thriving in South American rivers and temporary lakes caused by seasonal flooding, this freshwater dolphin is sometimes shockingly pink.
temporary.translationZh: 这种淡水豚在南美洲的河流和季节性洪水形成的临时湖泊中繁衍生息，有时会呈现出令人惊讶的粉红色。
temporary.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第4句

temporary.sentenceEn: It even reaches into the middle classes, as real wages have stagnated(不增长) for all but the very wealthy and temporary spells of financial instability are not uncommon.
temporary.translationZh: 这种不稳定性甚至蔓延至中产阶级，因为除极少数巨富人群外，大多数人的实际工资停滞不前，短暂的财务不稳定也屡见不鲜。

temporary.sentenceEn: There are many things that can cause confusion and memory loss, including health problems like temporary stoppage of breathing during sleep, high blood pressure, or depression, as well as medications(药物) like antidepressants.
temporary.translationZh: 有许多因素会导致意识模糊和记忆力减退，包括健康问题，如睡眠中呼吸暂时停止、高血压或抑郁症，以及抗抑郁药等药物。
temporary.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第2句

temporary.sentenceEn: I know they have at least two temporary positions available.
temporary.translationZh: 我知道他们至少有两个临时职位空缺。
temporary.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第4句

temporary.sentenceEn: After Hurricane Katrina interrupted routine delivery, temporary mail service points were set up.
temporary.translationZh: 卡特里娜飓风中断常规投递后，临时邮件服务点被设立起来。

temporary.sentenceEn: It is only a temporary measure.

timing.sentenceEn: Consequently, all human body functions also follow this daily rhythm, and the timing of behaviors like exercise or food intake can significantly influence your health.
timing.translationZh: 因此，人体的各项功能也遵循这种昼夜节律，而运动或进食等行为的时机也会显著影响您的健康。
timing.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第3句

timing.sentenceEn: I believe taking drug timing into account could help make treatments more effective and help more people worldwide.
timing.translationZh: 我相信，将用药时机纳入考量有助于提高治疗效果，并造福全球更多的人。
timing.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第2句

timing.sentenceEn: Based on that timing , they indicate barley may have arrived in the region not as food, but as raw material for beer brewing.
timing.translationZh: 根据这一时间线，研究人员指出，大麦传入该地区可能并非作为食物，而是作为酿造啤酒的原料。
timing.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第11句

timing.sentenceEn: While most people will still probably need, and be, to some extent, clock-timers, task-based timing should be used when performing a job that requires more creativity.
timing.translationZh: 虽然大多数人可能仍然需要在某种程度上成为时间计时者，但在执行需要更多创造力的工作时，应该采用任务计时方式。
timing.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第2句

timing.sentenceEn: What do we learn from the passage about the timing of our behaviors?
timing.translationZh: 关于我们行为的时间安排，我们可以从这篇文章中了解到什么？

timing.sentenceEn: Task-based timing is preferred for doing creative work.
timing.translationZh: 从事创造性工作时，基于任务的时间安排更为可取。

tone.sentenceEn: This is intentional as the informal tone of the assistant helps create an emotional attachment.
tone.translationZh: 这是有意为之的，因为语音助手的非正式语气有助于建立情感联系。

tone.sentenceEn: It sounds self-righteous(自以为是的) and sets the wrong tone .
tone.translationZh: 这听起来自以为是，而且会造成不好的影响。
tone.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

tone.sentenceEn: While some of the budget airlines might use brighter, bolder shades, most others go with softened tones .
tone.translationZh: 虽然部分廉价航空公司可能会使用更鲜艳、更大胆的色调，但大多数其他航空公司则选用柔和的色彩。
tone.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

tone.sentenceEn: I need to do some exercise to tone up.
tone.translationZh: 我需要做些运动来锻炼塑形。
tone.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第3句

tone.sentenceEn: Curious if the left hemispheres were indeed remaining awake to process information detected in the surrounding environment, Dr. Sasaki re-ran the experiment while presenting the sleeping participants with a mix of regularly timed beeps(蜂鸣声) of the same tone and irregular beeps of a different tone during the night.
tone.translationZh: 佐佐木博士好奇左脑半球是否确实保持清醒以处理周围环境中检测到的信息，于是她重新进行了实验。在夜间，她向熟睡的参与者播放由定时响起的相同音调蜂鸣声和不定时响起的不同音调蜂鸣声混合而成的声音。
tone.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

tone.sentenceEn: She analyzed the negative effect of irregular tones on brains.
tone.translationZh: 她分析了不规则音调对大脑的负面影响。

traditionally.sentenceEn: The use of rows and their minimal adaptations to "U" shape were traditionally intended to maximize on-task behavior and reduce distraction from the teacher.
traditionally.translationZh: 传统上，采用排状排布及其向“U”型布局的微调，旨在最大程度地提高学生的专注度，并减少对教师教学的干扰。
traditionally.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

traditionally.sentenceEn: The clone has already performed better than traditionally bred dogs on several tests.
traditionally.translationZh: 在多项测试中，这只克隆犬的表现已经优于传统繁育的犬只。
traditionally.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第5句

traditionally.sentenceEn: Traditionally , boosters, fuel tanks and other components are treated as expendable.
traditionally.translationZh: 传统上，助推器、燃料箱和其他组件都被视为一次性使用的消耗品。
traditionally.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

traditionally.sentenceEn: The second reason they say is lifestyle changes in the country, with people dedicating less time to breakfast when bread would traditionally be eaten with butter and jam.
traditionally.translationZh: 他们提出的第二个原因是法国人的生活方式发生了变化，人们花在早餐上的时间减少了，而传统上早餐会搭配黄油和果酱吃面包。
traditionally.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第4句

traditionally.sentenceEn: These are traditionally very similar to college classes.
traditionally.translationZh: 传统上，这些项目与大学课程非常相似。
traditionally.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

traditionally.sentenceEn: This would be a form of expropriation(侵占), with employees absorbing production costs that have traditionally been paid by the employer.
traditionally.translationZh: 这将构成一种侵占，即由员工承担传统上本应由雇主支付的生产成本。
traditionally.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第8段，第3句

trigger.sentenceEn: Whereas people with tooth sensitivity may complain, for example, of tooth pain triggered by heat or cold, the nerves in the inner layer don't sense temperature.
trigger.translationZh: 虽然牙齿敏感的人可能会抱怨，例如，牙齿因热或冷而引发疼痛，但内层的神经其实并不感知温度。
trigger.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第3句

trigger.sentenceEn: It seems to trigger a type of social anxiety.
trigger.translationZh: 这似乎引发了一种社交焦虑。
trigger.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第3句

trigger.sentenceEn: But if there's one thing that triggers widespread employee frustration, it's an IT transformation project gone wrong, where swollen expectations have been popped and a long list of promised efficiencies has been reversed.
trigger.translationZh: 但是，如果说有什么事情最容易引发员工普遍不满的话，那就是失败的信息技术转型项目——过高的期望化为泡影，一大堆承诺的效率提升反而变成了效率下降。
trigger.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第5句

trigger.sentenceEn: Other emotions triggered by math include feelings of "tension and frustration".
trigger.translationZh: 数学引发的其他情绪还包括“紧张和沮丧”感。
trigger.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第3句

trigger.sentenceEn: A burglar has to continuously jam the wireless security device to avoid triggering the alarm, both inside and outside the house.
trigger.translationZh: 窃贼必须持续干扰无线安防设备，以避免触发警报，无论是在屋内还是屋外。

trigger.sentenceEn: Trigger its built-in alarm system at once.
trigger.translationZh: 立即触发其内置警报系统。

tipping.sentenceEn: That's because he plans to ban tipping in favor of paying his servers an actual living wage.
tipping.translationZh: 这是因为他计划取消小费制度，转而向服务员支付能够维持生计的实际工资。
tipping.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第3句

tipping.sentenceEn: Most of you probably think that you hate tipping , too.
tipping.translationZh: 你们大多数人可能也觉得自己讨厌给小费。
tipping.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

tipping.sentenceEn: No matter how the math works out, you persistently view restaurants with voluntary tipping systems as being a better value, which makes it extremely difficult for restaurants and bars to do away with the tipping system.
tipping.translationZh: 无论怎么算，人们总是觉得有自愿 tipping 机制的餐厅更划算，这就使得餐馆和酒吧极难废除小费制度。
tipping.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第5句

tipping.translationZh: 实际上，你们很享受给小费这件事！
tipping.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第3句

tipping.sentenceEn: Why do many people love tipping according to the author?
tipping.translationZh: 根据作者的观点，为什么许多人喜欢给小费？

tipping.sentenceEn: He intends to get rid of the tipping practice.

tremendous.sentenceEn: Still, cats in the workplace have been a tremendous success for the company.
tremendous.translationZh: 尽管如此，职场猫咪计划在该公司取得了巨大成功。
tremendous.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第1句

tremendous.sentenceEn: Research on the language of numbers shows, more and more, that one of our species' key characteristics is tremendous linguistic(语言的) and cognitive diversity.
tremendous.translationZh: 关于数字语言的研究越来越表明，我们人类物种的关键特征之一是巨大的语言和认知多样性。

tremendous.sentenceEn: "Manufacturing is the one system where you have got the biggest source of innovation, the biggest source of economic growth, and the biggest source of great jobs in the past. You can see it changing. That's an opportunity to shape that system differently, and if we can, it will have tremendous significance."
tremendous.translationZh: “制造业是一个体系，它曾是创新的最大源泉、经济增长的最大动力以及优质就业岗位的最大提供者。如今，你能看到它正在发生变革。这是一个以不同方式重塑这一体系的机会，如果我们能做到，将具有极其重大的意义。”
tremendous.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第4句

tremendous.sentenceEn: "There's tremendous opportunity to get a generation of people for whom suffering isn't their thing," Cocalis said.
tremendous.translationZh: 科卡利斯表示：“我们有巨大的机会吸引新一代人，对他们来说，骑行的痛苦体验已经不合时宜。”
tremendous.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第2句

tremendous.sentenceEn: You discount the tremendous amount of work they've done to get to where they are.
tremendous.translationZh: 你忽视了他们为达到今天的成就所付出的巨大努力。
tremendous.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第8句

tremendous.sentenceEn: Manufacturing and shipping of plastic water bottles consume a tremendous amount of fossil fuels.
tremendous.translationZh: 塑料水瓶的生产和运输消耗了大量的化石燃料。

tutor.sentenceEn: Feedback from the teachable agents further enhances the tutors' learning.
tutor.translationZh: 来自可教代理的反馈进一步增强了辅导者的学习效果。
tutor.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

tutor.sentenceEn: Researchers have found that students who sign up to tutor others work harder to understand the material, recall it more accurately and apply it more effectively.
tutor.translationZh: 研究人员发现，那些主动报名辅导他人的学生，会更努力地去理解学习材料，更准确地记忆内容，并且更有效地运用所学知识。
tutor.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

tutor.sentenceEn: Student tutors feel upset when their teachable agents fail, but happy when these virtual pupils succeed as they derive pride and satisfaction from someone else's accomplishment.
tutor.translationZh: 当这些可教代理学习失败时，学生教师会感到沮丧；而当这些虚拟学生取得成功时，他们又会感到高兴，因为他们能从他人的成就中获得自豪感与满足感。
tutor.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第2句

tutor.sentenceEn: The agents' questions compel student tutors to think and explain the materials in different ways, and watching the agent solve problems allows them to see their knowledge put into action.
tutor.translationZh: 这些教学主体提出的问题迫使学生教师以不同方式思考和解释教学内容，而观察教学主体解决问题能让他们看到自己的知识被付诸实践。
tutor.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

tutor.sentenceEn: What is the key factor that eases student tutors ' learning?
tutor.translationZh: 促进学生辅导员学习的关键因素是什么？

tutor.sentenceEn: It is a tutor for computer science students.
tutor.translationZh: 它是计算机科学学生的导师。
